subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should subagent completion announce handoffs be treated as delivery-only LLM turns that disable all tool surfaces and reconcile interrupted announce runs without human restart recovery?
rationale: The patch is a plausible best fix, but it changes both security/tool exposure and persisted session recovery semantics, so automation should not own the final product/security boundary decision.

options.title: Accept the delivery-only invariant
options.body: Land this shape after exact-head CI is green, with announce completion handoffs tool-free across embedded, CLI, and Codex native paths and interrupted announce runs reconciled idle instead of resumed.

options.title: Require broader upgrade proof first
options.body: Ask for a fresh rebase plus hosted lint and a restart-recovery proof that covers mixed human and announce runs before deciding.

options.title: Pause for a different boundary design
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a narrower or explicit persisted run-kind model instead of the `announce:` run-id and classifier-based approach.

recommendation.title: Accept the delivery-only invariant
recommendation.body: Land this shape after exact-head CI is green, with announce completion handoffs tool-free across embedded, CLI, and Codex native paths and interrupted announce runs reconciled idle instead of resumed.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has recent session lifecycle and Codex native-thread history and is the strongest available owner for the combined session-state/security-boundary decision.
